svg.aria-label: S20 Miss handling and the fill path
svg.text: S20 Miss handling and the fill path
A template where a miss takes a fill buffer and asks the L2. The line comes back in 64 B halves, and past the L2 the request ships to the SLC or DRAM.
? One buffer holds each 64 B line in flight.
? A second miss to the line joins its waiters.
◇ Little's law gives at least seven, but the count is open.
? Demand loads and L1 prefetches share them.
the physical line address and the half wanted
a victim goes along when the set is full
the waiter takes its bytes as it lands
the write takes a bank cycle
a 128 B line is two 64 B halves
whether both halves come down is disputed
the run names where the line came from
A load that missed waits in its queue entry with the buffer number.
A prefetch that missed waits the same way, without a waiter.
~ inferred: patent reading or author reasoning
